displayName: OCI-AI-PD-003: AI — Jailbreak via Base64/Encoded Payload
description:
Detects prompt injection attempts using encoded payloads (base64, hex, ROT13) to bypass content filters

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_003", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%jailbreak%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%base64%') AND "value" > 0
